issues.where: crop 4, the backlit leaves on the right of the stem
issues.what: the sun is behind the leaves, but the blades stay an opaque, even dark green. No light comes through the thin tissue and the veins do not glow, so they look like painted cards
issues.fix: add subsurface translucency to the leaf blades so the backlit areas glow yellow-green, with the veins and thicker midribs showing darker against the light

issues.where: crops 2, 4 and 5, the edges of every leaf
issues.what: the frost and hair fringe is a white band of the same width that follows every serration on every leaf. It reads as a rim-light or outline effect, not frost crystals or hairs
issues.fix: vary the fringe in width, density and brightness along each edge, break it into separate hairs and crystals, and make it heavier on edges that face upward or into the wind

issues.what: each leaf is one flat green with white specks spread evenly across it. There is no change in tone across the blade and no visible thickness at the edges, so the leaves look waxy and card-flat
issues.fix: add colour variation across the blade, raised veins in the surface, slight cupping and a visible thickness at the edge, and cluster the frost specks along the veins and low spots

issues.where: crop 1, the bracts of the bud
issues.what: the bracts are close to identical in shape, curl and spacing, so the bud looks like copies of one bract
issues.fix: randomize the bract length, twist and tip curl, and add a few damaged or bent tips

issues.what: the glow around the sun is a smooth, perfectly round gradient with no variation from the fog, so it sits on top of the image
issues.fix: modulate the glow with fog density and add faint light shafts or uneven scattering
